M1_log_bytes.verdict: REJECTED as primary magnitude: Bath-inverted at scale, weakest discriminator

M2_productivity.verdict: Sign-safe by construction but degenerate: latest-prior parent trees are chains, gap~0 mechanically; keep as second axis

M3_blast_radius.def: log10(1+distinct destinations touched by same source in 10-min bin)
M3_blast_radius.verdict: WINNER: primary magnitude. Operationally meaningful, best discriminator, GR-distributed

bath_law_verdict: Terrestrial Bath (gap~1.2) NOT reproduced under ANY candidate: network event trees are chains/stars, not deep ETAS hierarchies. Gap statistic becomes a topology diagnostic (0=chain/star, 1.2=ETAS hierarchy), not a law.
two_axis_proposal: magnitude = (M3 blast radius [impact axis], M2 productivity [causal axis]); M1 demoted to size-law descriptor only
graph_duality: dst-anchored eta = repetition structure (triage); src-anchored eta = actor causal chains (kill chains). dst-eta cannot see cross-destination cascades (AMOS IOC events scatter over 8+ dst-clusters).
amos_blast_timeline: IOC destinations concentrated in cascade windows (t+0-120s: 17 IOC dsts; t+240-360s: 8), M3 does not spike for single-host cascades in 10-min bins (13 dsts vs 4-19 browsing) - M3 is a network-population magnitude
